question: Which of the following novels is written by the Indian author Kiran Desai?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Inheritance of Loss**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Inheritance of Loss** is a novel written by the Indian author Kiran Desai.
 
• Kiran Desai is an Indian author who won the Man Booker Prize in 2006 for this novel.
 
• The novel is set in the mid-1980s in a Himalayan town in India and explores themes of globalization, multiculturalism, and economic inequality.
 
• Other options listed are authored by different writers:
 
 
• **The Circle of Reason** is written by Amitav Ghosh.
 
• **The Golden House** is written by Salman Rushdie.
 
• **A Suitable Boy** is written by Vikram Seth.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kiran Desai** is the daughter of the renowned Indian author Anita Desai.
 
• The novel **The Inheritance of Loss** also won the National Book Critics Circle Fiction Award in 2007.
 
• Kiran Desai's work often explores complex themes related to identity, displacement, and the impact of colonialism.
